what: What Kwotient said about each game on the slate, filed by site/file-readings.js from the deployed edge and the app's own model.
first: the earliest reading of the game on this day, never overwritten. latest: the last, with the result once the game is over.
prior and mktProb are the home side's win probability in percent; fair and line are the home spread in points (negative favors home); edge is line minus fair, in points, on the side named.
box: a finished game's box score, compact — each side's eight fullest lines with every stat the edge sent.
